### What and why / Qué y por qué



### Type / Tipo

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Translation (new language or improvement)
- [ ] Documentation / packaging

### Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] New user-visible text is in English inside `gettext("…")`, and I ran `po/update.sh`
- [ ] Translations: `po/update.sh --check` passes and I tried it with `LANGUAGE=<code> cargo run`
- [ ] Capture/pipeline changes: tested manually (distribution, desktop, GPU and result below)
